author: blu
body: Proves unconditional evasion. A 2/2 whose Oracle text "can't be blocked" compiles to the Unblockable ability. It attacks into a 3/3 bear that could legally block a normal creature; the blocker AI must skip it, so it gets through and the defender takes 2. Conditional evasion ("can't be blocked except by walls") is NOT unblockable -- the except guard keeps Fear/Intimidate style text from becoming fully unblockable.
